turns.text:
ok can u edit my text to sam pls. i need to ask him to cover one of the saturdays he owes me but politely.. firm tho

"hey sam! so maybe if it's ok, could you possibly cover one saturday soon? you still owe me two saturdays from september and i opened solo at 6:30 this morning when you swapped out. no worries if not!! just maybe let me know?"

Happy to. Your draft is friendly, but the "maybe," "if it's ok," "possibly" and "no worries if not" make it easy to brush off. Here's a version that keeps it kind and clear:

"Hey Sam! You still owe me two Saturdays from September, and I opened solo at 6:30 this morning when you swapped out. Can you cover one of them soon? Let me know which Saturday works for you."

It asks directly, names the debt, and gives him a concrete next step.
hmm its kinda blunt.. can u soften it a little more. like maybe add a maybe back in 🫠

Sure, here's a middle ground that's warm without being easy to dodge:

"Hey Sam! Hope your weekend's going well. I opened solo at 6:30 this morning, and I realized you still owe me two Saturdays from September. Could you take one of them soon? Just let me know which Saturday works and I'll put it on the schedule. Thanks!"

I left out "maybe" on purpose, since the ask is the important part. If you want it gentler, the friendly opener and the "thanks" already do that.
ok yeah that works. i need this settled tonight so i can finish mapping next week in my planner

Then send it tonight, and you'll have a clear request waiting for him. If he hasn't replied by morning, you can pencil in the Saturday as tentative and adjust once he answers.

If you want a shorter option:

"Hey Sam! You still owe me two Saturdays from September. Can you cover one soon? Let me know which one works. Thanks!"
the first one is good. thank u!! ok im gonna eat now
You're welcome! Good luck with the planner. Enjoy your meal!
